reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️ Clunky, pushy, and just not it. I’ve tried a bunch of habit trackers, and this one just doesn’t hold up. I’m not even sure how to articulate exactly why it misses the mark it just feels clunky and unintuitive. The layout doesn’t flow naturally, logging habits is weirdly awkward, and the overall design makes things harder than they need to be.

What really frustrated me was how often I got prompted to leave a review over and over, even after I paid for the premium version. That alone killed the experience. If I’ve already subscribed, why am I still being hounded like that?

I wanted this to work, but it’s not helpful, and honestly, most other options I’ve tried are smoother, more thoughtful, and easier to stick with. This one just isn’t it.
